name: Chinese and Japanese Gardens (Jurong Lake Gardens)
description: 位于裕廊湖畔，巧妙结合了传统中式皇家园林建筑（白塔、石拱桥）与静谧日式枯山水的美丽双子公园。非常适合未接触过亚洲文化的游客来此沉浸式体验东方古典文化的美学与宁静。
descriptionEn: Located by Jurong Lake, this beautiful dual-park flawlessly combines traditional Chinese imperial landscape architecture (white pagodas, stone arch bridges) with serene Japanese Zen gardens. Highly recommended for tourists who haven't experienced Asian culture to immerse themselves in the aesthetics and tranquility of classical Eastern culture.
recommendNote: 两个园子通过一座美丽的桥梁相连，建议傍晚时分游览以避开烈日，晚霞中的双塔和湖面倒影非常出片。
recommendNoteEn: The two gardens are connected by a beautiful bridge. It's best to visit in the late afternoon to avoid the scorching sun. The sunset views of the twin pagodas and their reflections on the lake are highly photogenic.

attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisit: 傍晚 16:30 后（光线柔和，气候相对凉爽）
attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisitEn: After 4:30 PM (softer light and relatively cooler weather)
highlightsEn: Japanese Zen Garden and Bonsai Garden
